info.name: Booking System API
info.description: Complete API collection for the Booking System. Set {{base_url}} to http://localhost:8080 and {{token}} to your JWT access token.

query.description: PENDING | APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED

request.description: Ganti resource (mobil/ruangan) pada booking berstatus PENDING. Resource pengganti harus bertipe sama, berstatus AVAILABLE, dan tidak konflik jadwal.

Riwayat seluruh aktivitas booking (CREATE, APPROVE, REJECT, SUBSTITUTE_RESOURCE, ASSIGN, START, COMPLETE, dll). Field `description` berisi note yang diinput admin saat melakukan aksi, termasuk alasan penggantian resource. Akses: Admin (semua booking) atau User (hanya booking milik sendiri).
